concerns.text: SC-001 requires baseline elemental CTE values 'sourced from the NIST Thermophysical Properties of Substances database (external, not derived from the alloy dataset)'. T005 instead retrieves elemental CTEs from MP pure-element entries (e.g., mp-112 for Zr) — a different, non-mandated source. This silently relaxes the success criterion; either the task must use NIST or the spec must be amended with justification.

FR-008's fallback is 'PCA retaining the first two components and use these components as predictors'. T003 (following plan Phase 1.5) instead does 'PCA retaining components explaining ≥ 95 % variance with a Ridge model on the components' — an unauthorized relaxation of the two-component rule plus an added Ridge model the spec never authorizes.

T006 reuses a 'convergence guard' that records {"permutation_status": "skipped_low_n"} and skips the permutation test entirely when N < 50. FR-005 mandates ≥ 1000 iterations with no low-N exemption; the spec only asks for cautious interpretation below N=200 (plan power analysis). This is a retroactive narrowing of a MUST requirement.

FR-003 defines alloy family as 'the set of constituent elements (e.g., Zr-Cu-Al vs. Pd-Ni-P)'. T003 defines family as 'the ordered tuple of the two most abundant elements' — a different stratification variable than the spec mandates, silently changing the split semantics.

SC-005/FR-001 require ≥ 95 % of filtered API entries to be successfully collected. T002's verification checks schema validity and missing values but never computes or asserts the 95 % collection ratio; the coverage section claims '≥ 95 % collection' is covered by T001/T002 yet no task measures it.

T004 specifies 'n_estimators grid' with no concrete values (plan has the literal placeholder n_estimators=[[deferred]]). FR-004 requires 'a grid search over a range of parameter combinations'; an unspecified grid leaves the deliverable unverifiable. Specify concrete n_estimators values in the task.

The FeatureImportance entity declares a per-row spearman_rho field, but T007's feature_importance.csv column list ('model_type, feature_name, importance_score, rank, pearson_corr, abs_corr_rank') omits it; ρ/τ go only to a separate text file. Align the artifact with the declared data model or update the data model.
